text.aria-label: Title text 'The PV capacity weight stays mostly below 1 and moves in steps and short swings'

g.text: The PV capacity weight stays mostly below 1 and moves in steps and short swings

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'KEZ's filtered weight at each substation over the scored year, from the state at the end of each day, with a band of one posterior standard deviation (clipped to -1 to 3). Grey rules: holiday days. Light-blue spans: cold-snap days (a November to March day colder than the 10th percentile of such days from 2019-09 to 2024-06). A weight of 1 is the fitted effect. Weights are not interpretable.'
text.tspan: KEZ's filtered weight at each substation over the scored year, from the state at the end of each day, with a
band of one posterior standard deviation (clipped to -1 to 3). Grey rules: holiday days. Light-blue spans:
cold-snap days (a November to March day colder than the 10th percentile of such days from 2019-09 to 2024-06).
A weight of 1 is the fitted effect. Weights are not interpretable.
